title: 消費者心理学
subtitle: Psychology of Consumer
teachers:
KATO Juri
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Students will learn about:
(1) how to analyze consumer behavior from the perspective of basic psychology (psychology of perception, memories, emotion, cognitive psychology, and social psychology).
(2) psychological study of consumer behavior.
advice:
We will cover the following topics:

1. Consumer behavior from the perspective of the psychology of perception and sensation
2. Purchasing behavior from the perspective of the psychology of memories and learning
3. Advertisement from the perspective of cognitive and social psychology
4. Interpersonal influence in consumer behavior
5. Methodology of studying the psychology of consumers

This course is subject to the course credit system.
requiredKnowledge: Completion of the “Elements of Psychology” and “Method of Psychological Research” courses is recommended.

activityGoals.body: Ability to understand the influence of perception and sensation on consumer behavior.
Ability to understand the relationship between cognitive processing, memories and purchasing behavior.
Ability to understand the influence of emotion and social environment on consumer behavior.
Ability to understand psychological research and experiments of consumer behavior.
